Bitcoin Realized Cap Has Just Set A New Record
According to data from the on-chain analytics firm Glassnode, the capital inflows into Bitcoin have accelerated recently based on the trend in the cryptocurrency’s Realized Cap.
The “Realized Cap” here refers to an on-chain capitalization model for BTC that calculates the asset’s total value by assuming that the ‘real’ value of each coin in circulation is the price at which it was last transacted on the network.
